# T-3: Preserve attempt logs

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Write a distinct final-regression raw log for each invocation and point result artifacts and issue-log entries at the matching attempt log.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Two invocations create `final-regression-attempt-001.log` and `final-regression-attempt-002.log` without deleting the first log.
- The latest result artifact points to the latest attempt log.
- Failure issue-log entries point to the attempt log from the same failed invocation.

## Implementation Notes
Introduce a bounded attempt path allocator near final-regression artifact writing. Update durable/resettable artifact paths to retain the attempt-log pattern rather than only a single fixed log file.

## Test Strategy
Unit and spec-local tests execute repeated final-regression attempts and assert both file retention and path references.
